definitions.explanation: The galaxy containing our solar system, appearing as a faint band of light stretching across the night sky.

examples.japanese: {七夕|たなばた}の{夜|よる}、{天|あま}の{川|がわ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: On the night of Tanabata, I saw the Milky Way.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}では{天|あま}の{川|がわ}がはっきり{見|み}える。
examples.english: In the countryside, you can see the Milky Way clearly.

examples.japanese: {天|あま}の{川|がわ}には{数千億|すうせんおく}の{星|ほし}がある。
examples.english: The Milky Way contains hundreds of billions of stars.

examples.japanese: {七夕|たなばた}の{伝説|でんせつ}では、{織姫|おりひめ}と{彦星|ひこぼし}が{天|あま}の{川|がわ}を{渡|わた}って{年|とし}に{一度|いちど}{会|あ}う。
examples.english: In the Tanabata legend, Orihime and Hikoboshi cross the Milky Way to meet once a year.

examples.japanese: {街灯|がいとう}もない{山奥|やまおく}の{温泉|おんせん}で{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}に{浸|つ}かりながら{天|あま}の{川|がわ}を{眺|なが}めるのは、{最高|さいこう}の{贅沢|ぜいたく}だ。
examples.english: Soaking in an outdoor hot spring deep in the mountains with no streetlights, gazing at the Milky Way — that's the ultimate luxury.

notes:
{天|あま}の{川|がわ} literally means 'River of Heaven,' the Japanese name for the Milky Way.

TANABATA LEGEND ({七夕|たなばた}):
In the famous legend, {織姫|おりひめ} (Vega) and {彦星|ひこぼし} (Altair) are lovers separated by the {天|あま}の{川|がわ}, allowed to meet only once a year on July 7th when magpies form a bridge across the celestial river.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {天|あま}の{川|がわ}が{見|み}える: can see the Milky Way
- {天|あま}の{川|がわ}を{渡|わた}る: to cross the Milky Way
- {天|あま}の{川|がわ}を{仰|あお}ぐ: to look up at the Milky Way

SCIENTIFIC TERMS:
- {銀河|ぎんが}: galaxy (general term)
- {銀河系|ぎんがけい}: the Milky Way galaxy (scientific)
- {天の川銀河|あまのがわぎんが}: Milky Way Galaxy

BEST VIEWING:
- Summer months in Japan
- Away from city lights ({光害|こうがい})
